purpose: Document independent city-specific registry discovery and bounded anonymous geometry access investigation.
assessment: Fresh English and Chinese searches found official Wenling evidence for a municipal Natural Resources and Planning Bureau, a real-estate registration service center, cadastral-map/archive work, and a public geospatial framework. No anonymous parcel feature service, schema, CRS, native parcel ID, or safe parcel geometry was found.
registryAssessment: Local registry custody is evidenced, so registryFound is true. The evidence does not establish a public machine-readable cadastral endpoint or runtime adapter qualification.
